newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Bullish market takes all Estonian stocks higher.
newsitem.headline: Bullish market takes all Estonian stocks higher.

text.p: Hansapank and Forekspank both performed well on Estonia's bullish market on Tuesday with gains expected to last into coming days, dealers said.
Total volume on the official list reached 49.5 million kroons and the Tallinn Stock Exchange index continued to climb with a 2.17 percent increase to 225.24.
"The volume was not as high as expected, given the rise in prices but it was a very bullish market with strong buying pressure," one dealer said.
Forekspank was the most active with turnover worth 12.7 million kroons. The bank firmed 3.00 kroons to 157.05 kroons.
Hansapank was equally active with 12.7 million kroons traded and it gained to close 5.50 kroons higher at 226.50.
"Foreign interest in Hansapank took the price up by five kroons and the market just came with it," one trader said.
Tallinna Pank was active with 9.3 million kroons of shares changing hands to end higher to 69.09 kroons with a 1.84 kroons increase.
Hoiupank was 2.20 kroons higher to close on 113.30 kroons with turnover of 8.3 million kroons.
Among other stocks, Union Bank saw moderate trade to finish 0.10 kroons higher on 45.35 kroons in trade of 45.35 million kroons of shares.
Tallinn Pharma, a pharmaceuticals company, turned over 1.2 million kroons of shares to end the day 2.00 kroons higher on 117.50 kroons.
On the free market, 7.2 million kroons of shares were traded with diversified industrialist Norma and Rakvere meat plant the most active stocks.
"Norma's profit for February was good and investors have responded," one trader said.
Tallinn Department Store ended the day 2.05 kroons higher on 82.20 kroons after the release of their 1996 results.
